description.en: TypeScript best practices. Use when reading or editing any .ts or .tsx file.
description.zh: TypeScript 的最佳写法。读或改任何 .ts 或 .tsx 文件时使用。

blocks.zh: # TypeScript best practices（TypeScript 最佳写法）
先套用 **type-system-discipline** 这个原则技能。

blocks.en:
| Rule | Summary |
|------|---------|
| Discriminated unions | Model variants with a `kind` literal discriminant so impossible states can't be represented. No optional-field bags. |
| Branded types | Brand primitives with `& { readonly __brand: "X" }` so they can't be mixed up. Validate once at the boundary. A brand comes from a verifying type guard (`input is AgentId`), never from `as`. |
| Constructive modeling | Build the shape so the illegal value can't be constructed. `[T, ...T[]]` for non-empty, `[T, T][]` for even length, `start` plus `duration` for a range. Not a runtime guard, not a wish for refinement types. |
| Simplest total type | Keep `T[]` while every operation on it stays total. Strengthen to `NonEmpty<T>` only where the loose type forces `!`, a cast, or a "should never happen" throw. |
| `unknown` over `any` | External data is `unknown`. |
| Schemas before guards | Before hand-writing a property-by-property type guard, use the repository's runtime schema library and infer the type from the schema, such as `z.infer`. |
| No `as` casts | Every `as` is a runtime crash waiting. Cast only after validation. |
| Narrowing hierarchy | Discriminant switch > `in` operator > `typeof`/`instanceof` > user-defined type guard > `as`. |
| Type guards | Must verify the claim. A lying guard is worse than `as` because the bug hides behind a name that says it's safe. Name them `isX` or `hasX`. |
| Exhaustiveness | Inline `const _exhaustive: never = x;` in default arms so the compiler errors when a new variant is added. |
| `satisfies` over `as` | Validates the value without widening literal types. |
| Boundary validation | Parse where data crosses in, into a named domain type. `Record<string, unknown>` (however spelled) stops at that parse. Trust types inside. See the **boundary-discipline** principle skill. |
| Schema-derived types | Reach for `Pick`/`Omit`/`Parameters`/`ReturnType`/`Awaited`/`typeof` before declaring a new interface. |
| Object args | Pass objects, not positional, so argument order is self-documenting. Skip on hot paths (per-frame render, tokenizers, parsers). |
| Real tests | Don't mock what you can run. Prefer the framework's real test primitives with leak/disposable checks, and verify UI in a running build. Mock only what you can't run locally. |
| Structured telemetry | Prefer structured logger diagnostics with enough context to debug from an id. No `console.log` in shipped code. |
blocks.zh:
| 规则 | 要点 |
|------|---------|
| 可辨识联合 | 用一个 `kind` 字面量做标记来表示几种变体，让不可能的状态根本写不出来。不要用一袋可选字段。 |
| 品牌类型 | 用 `& { readonly __brand: "X" }` 给基本类型打上品牌，让它们没法被混用。在边界上校验一次。品牌只能来自一个真正做了校验的类型守卫（`input is AgentId`），绝不能来自 `as`。 |
| 用结构来建模 | 把类型的形状搭成非法的值根本造不出来。非空用 `[T, ...T[]]`，偶数长度用 `[T, T][]`，范围用 `start` 加 `duration`。不是靠运行时检查，也不是指望精化类型。 |
| 最简单的完备类型 | 只要对它的每个操作都能处理所有情况，就保持 `T[]`。只有在宽松的类型逼你用 `!`、类型断言，或者抛一个「不应该发生」的错误时，才收紧成 `NonEmpty<T>`。 |
| 用 `unknown` 不用 `any` | 外来数据一律是 `unknown`。 |
| 先用 schema 再写守卫 | 手写逐个属性检查的类型守卫之前，先用仓库里的运行时 schema 库，从 schema 推出类型，比如 `z.infer`。 |
| 不用 `as` 断言 | 每个 `as` 都是一个等着发生的运行时崩溃。只在校验之后才断言。 |
| 收窄类型的优先顺序 | 按标记 switch > `in` 运算符 > `typeof`/`instanceof` > 自定义类型守卫 > `as`。 |
| 类型守卫 | 必须真的校验它声称的事。一个撒谎的守卫比 `as` 更糟，因为 bug 藏在一个说它很安全的名字后面。命名为 `isX` 或 `hasX`。 |
| 穷尽检查 | 在 default 分支里直接写 `const _exhaustive: never = x;`，这样新加一种变体时编译器会报错。 |
| 用 `satisfies` 不用 `as` | 校验值，同时不把字面量类型放宽。 |
| 在边界上校验 | 在数据进来的地方解析，转成一个有名字的领域类型。`Record<string, unknown>`（不管怎么写）到这次解析就为止。进来之后就信任类型。见 **boundary-discipline** 原则技能。 |
| 从已有定义推导类型 | 声明新 interface 之前，先用 `Pick`/`Omit`/`Parameters`/`ReturnType`/`Awaited`/`typeof`。 |
| 用对象传参 | 传一个对象，不按位置传参，这样参数顺序一看就懂。热点路径上不用（每帧渲染、分词器、解析器）。 |
| 真实的测试 | 能跑的就别模拟。优先用框架真实的测试基础设施，并带上泄漏 / 资源释放检查；界面要在跑起来的构建里验证。只模拟本地跑不起来的东西。 |
| 结构化的运行记录 | 优先用结构化日志记录诊断信息，上下文要足够，光凭一个 id 就能排查。上线的代码里不留 `console.log`。 |

lessons.quoteZh: 先套用 **type-system-discipline** 这个原则技能。

zh.title: 先指向总原则再给细则
zh.does: 它先按通用的类型原则想清楚，再用下面的 TypeScript 写法落到代码里，表里没写到的情况也有章可循。
zh.why: 细则总有列不全的时候；开头一句指向背后的总原则，AI 遇到表外的情况就知道该往哪个方向判断。
zh.try: 给一串具体要求前先说总目标：「总原则是让老人一眼看懂；下面几条只是例子：字大、少按钮、不用英文。」

en.title: Point to the principle first
en.does: It thinks with the general type principles first, then applies the TypeScript rules, so cases the table misses still have a guide.
en.why: A rule list is never complete; one opening line naming the principle behind it tells the AI which way to lean off the list.
en.try: Before a list of specifics, give the aim: 'The goal is that older users get it at a glance; for example big text, few buttons, no English.'

lessons.quote: Discriminant switch > `in` operator > `typeof`/`instanceof` > user-defined type guard > `as`.
lessons.quoteZh: 按标记 switch > `in` 运算符 > `typeof`/`instanceof` > 自定义类型守卫 > `as`。

zh.title: 用一行排好先后
zh.does: 要判断数据是哪种类型时，它从最可靠的写法开始用，`as` 只当最后一招。
zh.why: 一串「>」把好几种做法排成一条队，AI 一眼就知道先试哪个、哪个是下策，不用逐个解释。
zh.try: 有几种做法时直接排个序：「先查官方文档 > 再看 GitHub issue > 最后才看博客。」

en.title: Rank the options in one line
en.does: When it must tell types apart it starts from the safest method and keeps `as` as a last resort.
en.why: A chain of ">" lines the choices up, so the AI sees which to try first and which is worst, without a paragraph each.
en.try: With several ways to do something, rank them: "Official docs > GitHub issues > blog posts."

lessons.quote: A lying guard is worse than `as` because the bug hides behind a name that says it's safe.
lessons.quoteZh: 一个撒谎的守卫比 `as` 更糟，因为 bug 藏在一个说它很安全的名字后面。

zh.title: 点破看似更好的做法
zh.does: 它写的 `isX` 函数会真的检查每个字段，不会写一个名字好听、其实什么都不查的空壳。
zh.why: AI 以为「换个正式的写法」就算改进；直接说明这种写法为什么更危险，就挡住了表面合规。
zh.try: 遇到容易走形式的地方先点破：「加了 try/catch 却什么都不处理，比不加更糟，因为错误被藏起来了。」

en.title: Expose the fake improvement
en.does: Its `isX` functions really check each field, instead of a nicely named shell that checks nothing.
en.why: AIs take a more formal form as progress; saying why it's more dangerous blocks compliance in name only.
en.try: Where form can replace substance, call it out: "An empty try/catch is worse than none, because it hides the error."

lessons.quote: Skip on hot paths (per-frame render, tokenizers, parsers).
lessons.quoteZh: 热点路径上不用（每帧渲染、分词器、解析器）。

zh.title: 规则后面紧跟例外
zh.does: 它平时用对象传参，但在每帧都要跑的代码里不会为了守规矩把性能拖慢。
zh.why: 例外和规则写在同一格，还给了具体场景，AI 就不会死守规则，也不会把例外扩大到别处。
zh.try: 立规矩时顺手写上例外：「回复都用中文；但报错信息和命令原样保留英文。」

en.title: Put the exception beside the rule
en.does: It passes objects by default, but won't slow down code that runs every frame just to follow the rule.
en.why: With the exception in the same cell and concrete cases named, the AI neither over-applies the rule nor stretches the exception.
en.try: When you set a rule, add the exception: "Reply in Chinese, but keep error messages and commands in English."

compare.without: 用 `as` 把类型硬转过去，先让编译通过
compare.with: 在数据进来的地方先校验，校验过了才转类型

compare.without: 用一堆可选字段拼出几种情况
compare.with: 给每种情况加 `kind` 标记，不可能的组合写不出来
外部数据标成 `unknown`，用项目的 schema 库解析

zh.intro: 先套用 type-system-discipline 原则，再给一张 16 条规则的表，从用 `kind` 区分情况、外部数据用 `unknown`，到测试少 mock、发布的代码不留 `console.log`。例子放在 `references/patterns.md`。

compare.without: Forces types through with `as` so the code compiles.
compare.with: Validates data where it enters, and casts only after that check.

compare.without: Models variants as a bag of optional fields.
compare.with: Tags each variant with a `kind` literal so impossible states can't exist.
Types outside data as `unknown` and parses it with the repo's schema library.

en.intro: It applies the type-system-discipline principle first, then gives a 16-rule table, from `kind` unions and `unknown` for outside data to real tests and no `console.log` in shipped code. Examples live in `references/patterns.md`.
